verses.text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ

trs.20: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].<sup foot_note=197453>1</sup>
trs.85: The Hour draws near; the moon is split in two.
trs.22: The Hour (of Judgment) is nigh, and the moon is cleft asunder.
trs.203: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has been cleft asunder (the people of Makkah requested Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to show them a miracle, so he showed them the splitting of the moon).<sup foot_note=154953>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ

trs.20: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."<sup foot_note=197454>1</sup>
trs.85: Whenever the disbelievers see a sign, they turn away and say, ‘Same old sorcery!’
trs.22: But if they see a Sign, they turn away, and say, "This is (but) transient magic."
trs.203: And if they see a sign, they turn away, and say: "This is continuous magic."

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

trs.20: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
trs.85: They reject the truth and follow their own desires––everything is recorded––
trs.22: They reject (the warning) and follow their (own) lusts but every matter has its appointed time.
trs.203: They belied (the Verses of Allâh - this Qur’ân), and followed their own lusts. And every matter will be settled (according to the kind of deeds: good deeds will take their doers to Paradise, and similarly evil deeds will take their doers to Hell).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

trs.20: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.
trs.85: although warning tales that should have restrained them have come down to them––
trs.22: There have already come to them Recitals wherein there is (enough) to check (them),
trs.203: And indeed there has come to them news (in this Qur’ân) wherein there is (enough warning) to check (them from evil),

verses.text_uthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ

trs.20: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
trs.85: farreaching wisdom––but these warnings do not help:
trs.22: Mature wisdom;- but (the preaching of) Warners profits them not.
trs.203: Perfect wisdom (this Qur’ân), but (the preaching of) warners benefit them not.

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ

trs.20: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller<sup foot_note=197455>1</sup> calls to something forbidding,
trs.85: so [Prophet] turn away from them. On the Day the Summoner will summon them to a horrific event,
trs.22: Therefore, (O Prophet,) turn away from them. The Day that the Caller will call (them) to a terrible affair,
trs.203: So (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) withdraw from them. The Day that the caller will call (them) to a terrible thing.

verses.text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ

trs.20: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
trs.85: eyes downcast, they will come out of their graves like swarming locusts
trs.22: They will come forth,- their eyes humbled - from (their) graves, (torpid) like locusts scattered abroad,
trs.203: They will come forth, with humbled eyes from (their) graves as if they were locusts spread abroad,

verses.text_uthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ

trs.20: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
trs.85: rushing towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will cry, ‘This is a stern day!’
trs.22: Hastening, with eyes transfixed, towards the Caller!- "Hard is this Day!", the Unbelievers will say.
trs.203: Hastening towards the caller. The disbelievers will say: "This is a hard Day."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ

trs.20: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
trs.85: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them: they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is mad!’ Noah was rebuked,
trs.22: Before them the People of Noah rejected (their messenger): they rejected Our servant, and said, "Here is one possessed!", and he was driven out.
trs.203: The people of Nûh (Noah) denied (their Messenger) before them. They rejected Our slave, and said: "A madman!" and he was insolently rebuked and threatened.

verses.text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ

trs.20: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
trs.85: and so he called upon his Lord, ‘I am defeated: help me!’
trs.22: Then he called on his Lord: "I am one overcome: do Thou then help (me)!"
trs.203: Then he invoked his Lord (saying): "I have been overcome, so help (me)!"

verses.text_uthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ

trs.20: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
trs.85: So We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water,
trs.22: So We opened the gates of heaven, with water pouring forth.
trs.203: So We opened the gates of the heaven with water pouring forth.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ

trs.20: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
trs.85: burst the earth with gushing springs: the waters met for a preordained purpose.
trs.22: And We caused the earth to gush forth with springs, so the waters met (and rose) to the extent decreed.
trs.203: And We caused springs to gush forth from the earth. So the waters (of the heaven and the earth) met for a matter predestined.

verses.text_uthmani: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ

trs.20: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
trs.85: We carried him along on a vessel of planks and nails
trs.22: But We bore him on an (Ark) made of broad planks and caulked with palm-fibre:
trs.203: And We carried him on a (ship) made of planks and nails,

verses.text_uthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

trs.20: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
trs.85: that floated under Our watchful eye, a reward for the one who had been rejected.
trs.22: She floats under our eyes (and care): a recompense to one who had been rejected (with scorn)!
trs.203: Floating under Our Eyes: a reward for him who had been rejected!

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

trs.20: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
trs.85: We have left this as a sign: will anyone take heed?
trs.22: And We have left this as a Sign (for all time): then is there any that will receive admonition?
trs.203: And indeed, We have left this as a sign. Then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

trs.20: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.<sup foot_note=197456>1</sup>
trs.85: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
trs.22: But how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning?
trs.203: Then how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

trs.20: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
trs.85: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
trs.22: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
trs.203: And We have indeed made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any one who will remember (or receive admonition)?

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

trs.20: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
trs.85: The people of 'Ad also rejected the truth. How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
trs.22: The 'Ad (people) (too) rejected (Truth): then how terrible was My Penalty and My Warning?
trs.203: ‘Âd (people) belied (their Prophet, Hûd); then how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ

trs.20: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
trs.85: We released a howling wind against them on a day of terrible disaster;
trs.22: For We sent against them a furious wind, on a Day of violent Disaster,
trs.203: Verily, We sent against them a furious wind of harsh voice on a day of evil omen and continuous calamity.

verses.text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ

trs.20: Extracting the people<sup foot_note=197457>1</sup> as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
trs.85: it swept people away like uprooted palm trunks.
trs.22: Plucking out men as if they were roots of palm-trees torn up (from the ground).
trs.203: Plucking out men as if they were uprooted stems of date-palms.

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

trs.20: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
trs.85: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
trs.22: Yea, how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
trs.203: Then, how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

trs.20: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
trs.85: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
trs.22: But We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
trs.203: And We have indeed made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

trs.20: Thamūd denied the warning.
trs.85: The people of Thamud also rejected the warnings:
trs.22: The Thamud (also) rejected (their) Warners.
trs.203: Thamûd (people also) belied the warnings.

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ

trs.20: And said, "Is it one human being<sup foot_note=197458>1</sup> among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
trs.85: they said, ‘What? A man? Why should we follow a lone man from amongst ourselves? That would be misguided; quite insane!
trs.22: For they said: "What! a man! a Solitary one from among ourselves! shall we follow such a one? Truly should we then be straying in mind, and mad!
trs.203: And they said: "A man, alone among us - shall we follow him? Truly then we should be in error and distress (or madness)!"

verses.text_uthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ

trs.20: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
trs.85: Would a mes-sage be given to him alone out of all of us? No, he is an insolent liar!’
trs.22: "Is it that the Message is sent to him, of all people amongst us? Nay, he is a liar, an insolent one!"
trs.203: "Is it that the Reminder is sent to him [Prophet Sâlih عليه السلام] alone from among us? Nay, he is an insolent liar!"

verses.text_uthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ

trs.20: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
trs.85: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is the insolent liar,
trs.22: Ah! they will know on the morrow, which is the liar, the insolent one!
trs.203: Tomorrow they will come to know who is the liar, the insolent one!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ

trs.20: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.<sup foot_note=197459>1</sup>
trs.85: for We shall send them a she-camel to test them: so watch them [Salih] and be patient.
trs.22: For We will send the she-camel by way of trial for them. So watch them, (O Salih), and possess thyself in patience!
trs.203: Verily, We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them [O Sâlih عليه السلام], and be patient!

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ

trs.20: And inform them that the water is shared between them,<sup foot_note=197460>1</sup> each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
trs.85: Tell them the water is to be shared between them: each one should drink in turn.’
trs.22: And tell them that the water is to be divided between them: Each one's right to drink being brought forward (by suitable turns).
trs.203: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them, each one’s right to drink being established (by turns).

verses.text_uthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

trs.20: But they called their companion,<sup foot_note=197462>1</sup> and he dared<sup foot_note=197461>2</sup> and hamstrung [her].
trs.85: But they called their companion, who took a sword and hamstrung the camel.
trs.22: But they called to their companion, and he took a sword in hand, and hamstrung (her).
trs.203: But they called their comrade and he took (a sword) and killed (her).

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

trs.20: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
trs.85: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
trs.22: Ah! how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
trs.203: Then, how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ

trs.20: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
trs.85: We released a single mighty blast against them and they ended up like a fencemaker’s dry sticks.
trs.22: For We sent against them a single Mighty Blast, and they became like the dry stubble used by one who pens cattle.
trs.203: Verily, We sent against them a single Saihah (torment - awful cry), and they became like the stubble of a fold-builder.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

trs.20: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
trs.85: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
trs.22: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
trs.203: And indeed, We have made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

trs.20: The people of Lot denied the warning.
trs.85: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
trs.22: The people of Lut rejected (his) warning.
trs.203: The people of Lût (Lot) belied the warnings.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ

trs.20: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.
trs.85: We released a stonebearing wind against them, all except the family of Lot. We saved them before dawn
trs.22: We sent against them a violent Tornado with showers of stones, (which destroyed them), except Lut's household: them We delivered by early Dawn,-
trs.203: Verily, We sent against them a violent storm of stones (which destroyed them all), except the family of Lût (Lot), them We saved in the last hour of the night,

verses.text_uthmani: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ

trs.20: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
trs.85: as a favour from Us: this is how We reward the thankful.
trs.22: As a Grace from Us: thus do We reward those who give thanks.
trs.203: As a Favour from Us. Thus do We reward him who gives thanks (by obeying Us).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

trs.20: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
trs.85: He warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warning-
trs.22: And (Lut) did warn them of Our Punishment, but they disputed about the Warning.
trs.203: And he [Lût (Lot)] indeed had warned them of Our Seizure (punishment), but they did doubt the warnings!

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

trs.20: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
trs.85: they even demanded his guests from him- so We sealed their eyes- ‘ Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’-
trs.22: And they even sought to snatch away his guests from him, but We blinded their eyes. (They heard:) "Now taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
trs.203: And they indeed sought to shame his guest (by asking to commit sodomy with them). So We blinded their eyes, (saying) "Then taste you My Torment and My Warnings."

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

trs.20: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
trs.85: and early in the morning a punishment seized them that still remains-
trs.22: Early on the morrow an abiding Punishment seized them:
trs.203: And verily, an abiding torment seized them early in the morning.

verses.text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

trs.20: So taste My punishment and warning.
trs.85: ‘Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’
trs.22: "So taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
trs.203: "Then taste you My Torment and My Warnings."

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

trs.20: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
trs.85: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
trs.22: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
trs.203: And indeed, We have made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ

trs.20: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
trs.85: The people of Pharaoh also received warnings.
trs.22: To the People of Pharaoh, too, aforetime, came Warners (from Allah).
trs.203: And indeed, warnings came to the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) [through Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)].

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

trs.20: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
trs.85: They rejected all Our signs so We seized them with all Our might and power.
trs.22: The (people) rejected all Our Signs; but We seized them with such Penalty (as comes) from One Exalted in Power, able to carry out His Will.
trs.203: (They) belied all Our Signs, so We seized them with a Seizure of the All-Mighty, All-Capable (Omnipotent).

verses.text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

trs.20: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?
trs.85: ‘Are your disbelievers any better than these? Were you given an exemption in the Scripture?’
trs.22: Are your Unbelievers, (O Quraish), better than they? Or have ye an immunity in the Sacred Books?
trs.203: Are your disbelievers (O Quraish!) better than these [nations of Nûh (Noah), Lût (Lot), Sâlih, and the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) who were destroyed)? Or have you an immunity (against Our Torment) in the Divine Scriptures?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ

trs.20: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
trs.85: Do they perhaps say, ‘We are a great army and we shall be victorious’?
trs.22: Or do they say: "We acting together can defend ourselves"?
trs.203: Or say they: "We are a great multitude, victorious?"

verses.text_uthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ

trs.20: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].<sup foot_note=197463>1</sup>
trs.85: Their forces will be routed and they will turn tail and flee.
trs.22: Soon will their multitude be put to flight, and they will show their backs.
trs.203: Their multitude will be put to flight, and they will show their backs.

verses.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

trs.20: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
trs.85: But the Hour is their appointed time- the Hour is more severe and bitter:
trs.22: Nay, the Hour (of Judgment) is the time promised them (for their full recompense): And that Hour will be most grievous and most bitter.
trs.203: Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour will be more grievous and more bitter.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ

trs.20: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.<sup foot_note=197464>1</sup>.
trs.85: truly the wicked are misguided and quite insane––
trs.22: Truly those in sin are the ones straying in mind, and mad.
trs.203: Verily the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals) are in error (in this world) and will burn (in the Hell-fire in the Hereafter).

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

trs.20: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."<sup foot_note=197465>1</sup>
trs.85: on the Day when they are dragged on their faces in Hell. ‘Feel the touch of Hell.’
trs.22: The Day they will be dragged through the Fire on their faces, (they will hear:) "Taste ye the touch of Hell!"
trs.203: The Day they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire (it will be said to them): "Taste you the touch of Hell!"<sup foot_note=154954>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ

trs.20: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
trs.85: We have created all things in due measure;
trs.22: Verily, all things have We created in proportion and measure.
trs.203: Verily, We have created all things with Qadar (Divine Preordainments of all things before their creation as written in the Book of Decrees Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz).

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ

trs.20: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
trs.85: when We ordain something it happens at once, in the blink of an eye;
trs.22: And Our Command is but a single (Act),- like the twinkling of an eye.
trs.203: And Our Commandment is but one as the twinkling of an eye.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

trs.20: And We have already destroyed your kinds,<sup foot_note=197466>1</sup> so is there any who will remember?
trs.85: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past. Will anyone take heed?
trs.22: And (oft) in the past, have We destroyed gangs like unto you: then is there any that will receive admonition?
trs.203: And indeed, We have destroyed your likes; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

verses.text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

trs.20: And everything they did is in written records.
trs.85: Everything they do is noted in their records:
trs.22: All that they do is noted in (their) Books (of Deeds):
trs.203: And everything they have done is noted in (their) Records (of deeds).

verses.text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ

trs.20: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
trs.85: every action, great or small, is recorded.
trs.22: Every matter, small and great, is on record.
trs.203: And everything, small and big, is written down (in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz already beforehand i.e. before it befalls, or is done by its doer: الإيمان بالقدر) (See the Qur’ân V.57:22 and its footnote).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ

trs.20: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
trs.85: The righteous will live securely among Gardens and rivers,
trs.22: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers,
trs.203: Verily, The Muttaqûn (the pious - see V.2:2), will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers (Paradise).

verses.text_uthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ

trs.20: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.<sup foot_note=197467>1</sup>
trs.85: secure in the presence of an all-powerful Sovereign.
trs.22: In an Assembly of Truth, in the Presence of a Sovereign Omnipotent.
trs.203: In a seat of truth (i.e. Paradise), near the Omnipotent King (Allâh, the One, the All-Blessed, the Most High, the Owner of Majesty and Honour).
